3yhealth-3y-health:ashbyhq:1aa15f36-dd95.description: What We're Looking For: We’re expanding our autism services and need Board‑Certified Behavior Analysts (BCBAs) to serve as part‑time consultants. You will help us shape local care models, expand insurance contracts, and if interested, create a launch‑pad to build or grow your own independent practice—without the usual operational headache. Key Responsibilities: - We are looking for around 1 hr commitment per week - Advise on state regulations, cultural nuances, and care‑model innovation. - Advise on policies and outcome metrics to ensure evidence‑based, family‑centered care. - Act as the primary credentialed provider for the group when we are applying to commercial and Medicaid plans in your state. - Use and critique our all‑in‑one tech stack (scheduling, data, EHR, billing) to guide product improvements. - If you wish, start seeing clients on our platform and build your own practice over time (no upfront fees, full ops support). What We Provide: - World‑class operational support so you stay focused on clinical input. - Fully integrated practice‑management suite, payer enrollment team, and rapid‑pay billing. - Access to a nationwide BCBA peer community - Priority eligibility for a full practice‑owner track with Tilly Therapy whenever you’re ready. Ideal Candidate: - Active BCBA license in good standing in Pennsylvania. - License to practice in multiple states a plus - Familiarity with payer credentialing or utilization‑management processes is a plus. - Passion for expanding equitable autism care and experimenting with outcome‑driven models. - Enjoys autonomy and remote, flexible collaboration Compensation Compensation will be $100-150 per hour dependent on experience and geographic location. About Tilly Therapy At Tilly, we believe BCBAs deserve more — more freedom, more support, and more impact. That’s why we’ve created a platform where BCBAs can launch and grow your own ABA practice with no upfront costs and full operational support. We handle the logistics. You focus on care. For more information, please visit: https://tillytherapy.com/providers What Makes Tilly Different? - $0 upfront to join — No fees, no hidden costs. - Earn up to $320,000/year based on your client caseload and schedule. - Concierge assistance with LLC creation, business banking, and liability insurance. - Total flexibility — You choose your hours, clients, and care model. - World-class support — We take care of operations so you can focus on clinical outcomes. - Custom referral support to help you build your preferred caseload. What We Provide Practice Owners: - All-in-one software suite – Includes Practice Management, Scheduling, EHR, Data Collection, Billing, Onboarding, and mobile apps for you, your RBTs, and your clients. - Insurance partnerships – We’re in-network with 100+ payers at high market rates, giving you broad access to patients. - Practice launch support – We’ll help you start your own ABA company if you don’t already have one. - Fast payments – Get paid upfront per session. No more chasing down insurance. - Payroll made easy – We’ll run payroll for you and your RBTs if you’d like.

arootah-arootah:lever:96c6b1a0-8213-41e1.title: Senior Credit Analyst - Client Role
arootah-arootah:lever:96c6b1a0-8213-41e1.description: About the Company We are recruiting for our client, a high growth, dedicated direct lender, focused on small businesses across the country. Our client has a ten-year history and is passionate about empowering and partnering with businesses in their growth journey. In addition to providing fast, flexible financing, our client offers a complete payment processing solution to make the funding process easier and more supportive than ever before. The mission of our client is to refine, enhance, and unify financial products, delivering better solutions for businesses to grow. About the Role Our client is seeking a Senior Credit Analyst to join its growing credit and risk team. This role sits at the center of the lending decision process, responsible for evaluating financing opportunities, structuring transactions, and ensuring sound credit decisions across a portfolio of small and mid-sized business borrowers. The Senior Credit Analyst will partner closely with underwriting and risk leadership to assess borrower financial health, recommend loan terms, and help maintain a high-quality loan portfolio while supporting continued business growth. This role offers meaningful exposure to credit decision-making, deal structuring, and portfolio risk management in a fast-paced lending environment. The ideal candidate is a highly analytical professional who enjoys digging into financials, evaluating risk, and playing a direct role in approving and structuring financing transactions.
responsibilities: Perform comprehensive credit reviews including borrower credit reports, background checks, and public record searches such as liens, judgments, bankruptcies, lawsuits, corporate filings, and UCC records.
Analyze borrower financial performance through detailed review of bank statements, balance sheets, profit and loss statements, tax returns, and accounts receivable reports.
Conduct cash flow analysis to evaluate repayment capacity and determine overall borrower creditworthiness.
Recommend loan approvals, credit limits, and deal structures based on financial analysis and internal credit policies.
Assist in determining loan pricing and repayment structures, including weekly, bi-weekly, or monthly payment schedules.
Prepare thorough credit memoranda summarizing borrower financial profiles, risk considerations, and underwriting recommendations.
Collaborate with underwriting and risk leadership to review complex transactions and ensure alignment with credit guidelines.
Monitor borrower industries and market trends to identify emerging risks and lending opportunities.
Contribute to the ongoing development and refinement of credit policies, risk frameworks, and lending products.
Help maintain a disciplined underwriting process that balances portfolio growth with strong risk management.
qualifications: Strong financial analysis and credit evaluation skills with the ability to assess borrower risk and repayment capacity.
Excellent attention to detail with the ability to interpret financial statements and identify key risk factors.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, particularly in preparing credit memos and presenting recommendations.
Ability to manage multiple transactions simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
Sound judgment and decision-making ability when evaluating complex credit scenarios.
Collaborative mindset with the ability to work closely with underwriting, risk, and leadership teams.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and financial analysis tools.
Experience with CRM platforms such as Salesforce or similar systems is preferred.

brinc-brinc:ashbyhq:51cdc028-27ee-4c07-b.title: Account Executive, DFR
brinc-brinc:ashbyhq:51cdc028-27ee-4c07-b.description: ABOUT BRINC: At BRINC, we are redefining public safety with an innovative ecosystem of life-saving tools. Our journey started with the development of drones and ruggedized throw phones, designed to access unsafe areas and establish communication to de-escalate situations. Today, we've expanded into creating and deploying 911 response networks, where drones are dispatched to 911 calls to provide real-time visual data, enhancing safety and enabling de-escalation-focused responses. Our cutting-edge solutions are utilized by over 600 public safety agencies across America and the company has raised over $150M from investors, including Index Ventures, Motorola Solutions, Sam Altman, Dylan Field, Mike Volpe, Alexandr Wang and more. At BRINC, we are committed to recruiting the world's best talent to join us in our mission to support first responders in saving lives. *At this time we are only considering candidates who reside in the following states: Minnesota, Iowa, Indiana, Michigan, Greater New Jersey Area, Pennsylvania, Montana, Wyoming, North Dakota, South Dakota We are seeking a high-performing Account Executive with expertise in selling complex solutions into public safety agencies, Real Time Crime Centers (RTCCs), or Drone as First Responder (DFR) programs. This is an enterprise-level sales role that requires a proven track record of hitting at least 85%+ of your sales quota in current and prior positions. The ideal candidate thrives in a competitive, mission-driven environment, has established relationships within law enforcement or public safety command staff, and is comfortable managing long, consultative sales cycles for high-value technology solutions. Expect 50%+ travel to meet with decision-makers and advance opportunities across your territory. RESPONSIBILITIES - Proactively develop and close enterprise-level opportunities within your assigned territory. - Build strong, trusted relationships with public safety leaders — especially those responsible for DFR programs and Real Time Crime Centers. - Consistently manage a high-value pipeline, driving opportunities from discovery to close while meeting or exceeding assigned quotas. - Act as the primary point of contact for strategic accounts, ensuring alignment with customer objectives. - Partner with internal teams (Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, Product) to deliver exceptional pre- and post-sales experiences. - Conduct weekly territory and pipeline reviews with the sales team to share insights, best practices, and strategies. - Stay current on public safety trends, evolving DFR/RTCC needs, and competitor activity. BASIC REQUIREMENTS - Enterprise-level, quota-carrying field sales experience with a consistent record of 85%+ quota attainment. - Demonstrated success selling DFR solutions, RTCC technology, or comparable complex public safety systems. - Strong relationships with senior leadership and command staff in law enforcement/public safety. - Excellent client service skills: professional communication, executive presence, and stakeholder alignment. - Ability to travel domestically 50%+ of the time to meet with agencies. - Highly organized, motivated, and goal-oriented with a strong sense of urgency. - Comfortable managing long, consultative sales cycles while maintaining pipeline discipline. - Proficiency in Google Workspace and CRM platforms (Hubspot preferred). - Military or law enforcement background is a plus (not required). BRINC CULTURE VALUES: - Try the hard stuff - Be innovative - Invent the future - Move fast - Listen to end-users - Strive for excellence - Don’t build a dystopia - Be frugal - Save lives through technology If you’re interested in this role and in joining BRINC, we hope you’ll apply. We’d love to review your application and get to know more about you! bumbleinc-bumbleinc:lever:cc9ffb6a-aeac-.title: Associate Manager, Social Media
bumbleinc-bumbleinc:lever:cc9ffb6a-aeac-.description: Bumble is looking for an Associate Manager, Social Media who lives and breathes social – someone deeply tapped into internet culture, excited to make content, and eager to build their creative instincts and career in social media and brand marketing. Reporting to the Associate Director, Social Media, you’ll work closely with our Social Media Manager on the day-to-day execution of Bumble’s social presence across key platforms. You’ll help keep our channels active and culturally relevant by engaging with our community, attending events, spotting emerging trends, supporting social listening and reporting, publishing content, and jumping in to capture and create content yourself. We’re looking for someone who is just as comfortable organizing a content calendar as they are picking up an iPhone to film—or stepping in front of the camera themselves. You don’t need to be an expert editor yet, but you should be excited to learn, experiment, and develop your content creation skills. This is an opportunity for someone early in their career to get hands-on experience across the social ecosystem while developing a strong creative and strategic point of view.
responsibilities: Content Creation & Capture
Support the Social Media Manager in creating platform-native content for Bumble across TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube.
Be comfortable getting in front of the camera and appearing in Bumble social content.
Capture social-first photo and video content on an iPhone at events, activations, shoots, around the office, and in everyday cultural moments.
Confidently approach and engage people to participate in social content when a concept calls for it.
Develop your instincts for strong social-first content, including hooks, framing, pacing, storytelling, and editing.
Experiment with platform features, trending formats, sounds, and editing styles, proactively pitching ideas that feel relevant to Bumble.
Edit short-form video using CapCut and other social-first tools, turning raw footage, creator content, UGC, and existing brand assets into engaging, platform-native content.
Contribute ideas during brainstorms and be willing to jump in and make the idea—not just identify the trend.
Cultural Listening, Insights & POV
Stay closely tapped into TikTok, Instagram, emerging platforms, and internet culture, regularly surfacing trends, conversations, creators, and behaviors relevant to Bumble and our audience.
Go beyond sharing what’s trending by developing a point of view on why something is resonating and whether there’s a relevant way in for Bumble.
Monitor conversations around dating, relationships, singles culture, and Gen Z behavior to identify emerging themes and opportunities.
Surface community feedback, comments, and social insights that could inspire content or inform the broader team.
Analytics & Optimization
Monitor content performance across Bumble’s social channels and identify patterns in what’s working, what’s not, and why across hooks, formats, topics, and creative approaches.
Use performance signals and audience response to recommend ways to improve future content.
Support ongoing creative testing, documenting learnings and applying them to future content.
Track weekly performance and support monthly and campaign-level reporting.
Community & Cross-Functional Collaboration
Engage with Bumble’s social community and surface relevant conversations, feedback, and opportunities for the brand to participate.
Partner with teams across Marketing, Creative, Product Marketing, PR, Partnerships, and Member Love to support social content and campaigns.
Support coordination with creators, agencies, and external partners to keep assets, feedback, and deliverables moving.
Bring a social-first and Gen Z perspective to brainstorms, launches, and cultural moments.
Operational Excellence
Help manage the social content calendar and maintain a consistent posting cadence.
Schedule, publish, and QA content across platforms.
Keep assets, copy, approvals, and deadlines organized and proactively flag blockers.
Support the development of creative briefs, toolkits, and other materials for internal and external partners.
Ensure deadlines are met in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
Ensure content aligns with Bumble’s visual identity, brand values, and tone of voice.
qualifications: 1–2 years of experience in social media, digital marketing, community management, content creation, or a related field, including relevant internships or freelance experience.
You spend a lot of time on TikTok, Instagram, and emerging platforms and have strong instincts for how people actually communicate on them.
You’re comfortable being on camera and excited to appear in Bumble content when needed.
You’re comfortable picking up an iPhone and capturing content yourself—you don’t need a formal production setup to make something engaging.
You have experience with short-form video editing or are excited to develop your skills.
You’re comfortable approaching and engaging new people and can bring energy to content capture in real-world environments.
You’re interested in internet culture, dating and relationships, entertainment, and creators.
You’re highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple priorities.
You’re a strong writer and curious about understanding what makes content perform.
You’re proactive, collaborative, and excited to develop your creative point of view.
You notice details others might miss and take pride in getting things right before they go live.

cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:7e8.title: Kitchen Assistant (Sur La Table)
cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:7e8.team: 122 - Old Orchard - Sur La Table, 4999 Old Orchard Center, Suite L12, Skokie, IL 60077
cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:7e8.description: With over 58 stores and the largest avocational cooking program in the US, Sur La Table offers an unsurpassed selection of exclusive and premium-quality goods for the kitchen and table – and the culinary expertise and inspiration to go along with it. Whether the job entails interacting with our customers, driving digital growth, or providing vital behind-the-scenes support, we’re all here for the same reason – to roll up our sleeves and create happiness through cooking and sharing good food. Position Overview As a Kitchen Assistant at Sur La Table, you play a key role in inspiring customers throughout every stage of their culinary experience. With a passion for cooking, hospitality, and teamwork, the Kitchen Assistant supports the chefs to ensure smooth class operations and a #bestincenter experience, a company-wide standard for excellence in service. You’ll help bring culinary dreams to life by supporting our chefs, engaging with guests, and ensuring a clean, well-organized kitchen environment. Key Responsibilities Customer Experience & Brand Representation · Represent Sur La Table’s brand and culture by creating memorable, educational experiences that inspire repeat visits and customer loyalty. · Maintains expertise by staying current on products, actively engaging in available training, and independently seeking out additional resources. · Ensure exceptional customer experience by leading a customer-focused, Guest Obsessed culture in both the kitchen and retail sales floor. Sales & Business Performance · Assist chefs with class execution that drives repeat visits and positive customer feedback · Deliver class revenue goals by ensuring high enrollment, positive reviews, and guest return rates. · Consistently meet or exceed monthly sales goals, contributing to overall store revenue. Performance is measured by key KPIs such as individual sales volume, average transaction value, and customer conversion rates. Team Engagement & Store Support · Assist in setting up and breakdown of classes including organizing mise en place, prepping ingredients, and cleaning workstations · Clean and sanitize dishes and equipment promptly to ensure smooth kitchen operations. · Assist with restocking, organizing, and maintaining kitchen supplies and tools to support overall store readiness Operations & Compliance · Ensure compliance with food safety standards, local health codes, and sanitation regulations. · Properly handle all tools, ingredients, and kitchen equipment to maintain a safe and efficient work environment. · Maintain accurate inventory levels, minimize shrink, and control supply and culinary expenses. · May handle liquor, wine, and beer in compliance with state and location alcohol regulations, company policies, including enforcing age restrictions. · Ensure store safety and cleanliness, addressing any maintenance needs promptly. · Adhere to applicable wage and hour laws. Accurately records time worked according to SLT Policy. · Model and ensure consistent adherence to all Sur La Table policies and standard operating procedures (SOPs). Physical Requirements · Ability to communicate verbally and work cooperatively with associates and customers · Ability to remain standing for up to 4 hours at a time · Ability to move about the store directing class participants while selling to customers and retrieving merchandise from stockroom or sales floor · The capability to accurately perceive and differentiate variations in intensity or quality of flavors or odors, or to identify specific tastes or scents using the tongue or nose. · Ability to grab, reach, push, pull, bend, stoop, kneel and crouch to demonstrate, retrieve and/or replenish merchandise and/or cooking equipment. · Ability to use hands to seize, hold, grasp, turn, or otherwise to chop, whisk, slice, stir, juice and/or demonstrate other techniques. · Ability to lift and/or move merchandise weighing up to 50 lbs. · Ability to ascend/descend ladders to retrieve and/or move merchandise

With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation. As a Premium Support Engineer at Replit, you’ll be the front line for our highest-value customers — delivering fast, expert, and reliable technical support when it matters most. You’ll handle complex product issues, guide customers through critical incidents, and ensure every interaction meets the highest standard of quality and speed. Replit is at the forefront of AI-driven software development, and how we support customers is constantly evolving. You’ll play a critical role in shaping how Premium Support adapts to new products, new customer expectations, and AI-assisted workflows, operating effectively in ambiguity and driving clarity for your team. You’ll combine deep technical troubleshooting with calm, confident communication to keep builders moving — whether it’s an enterprise team deploying at scale or a top-tier developer relying on Replit to power their business. IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL: - Serve as the trusted front-line contact for large enterprise customers, guiding them on AI prompting best practices, resolving bugs, and turning feedback into a better product experience, whilst adhering to strict SLAs. - Diagnose, reproduce, and resolve complex technical issues across the Replit platform. - Escalate and track high-impact issues with Product and Engineering, ensuring timely fixes and transparent communication. - Lead customer-facing communications during outages or incidents. - Analyse recurring issues and identify process and documentation improvements to reduce time-to-resolution - Build and update internal tooling, automation, and documentation that improves team efficiency. - Partner with Engineering, Product, Sales and other internal teams to ensure Premium customers receive a consistent, high-quality experience. - Help onboard and mentor other support engineers, raising the team’s overall bar for responsiveness and quality. REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE: - 4+ years in technical support, developer support, or systems engineering. - Experience managing and delivering against operational SLAs for enterprise accounts - Strong hands-on debugging experience with JavaScript, Python, or similar languages, including the ability to read and reason through an unfamiliar codebase. - Working knowledge of APIs, databases, and Git-based CI/CD workflows. - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, able to convey technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. - Familiarity with support tools like Zendesk, Linear, Slack, and internal debugging utilities. - Proven ability to manage multiple high-priority issues simultaneously while maintaining accuracy and composure. - A proactive, ownership-driven mindset and genuine empathy for customers building on Replit. NICE TO HAVE: - Has used Replit in the last 3 to 6 months. - Experience working with IDEs, terminals, or other common developer tools. - Experience with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, etc.). - Exposure to cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or similar). WHAT WE VALUE: - Problem-solving mindset: Ability to approach complex operational challenges systematically and devise effective solutions - Self-directed and autonomous: Capable of working independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams - Strong communication skills: Ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences - Continuous learning: Passion for staying current with industry best practices and new technologies - Focus on automation: Strong belief in automating repetitive tasks and building self-healing systems Note: This role will begin as remote, with plans to transition to a hybrid model once we establish a local office presence. farfetchlever-farfetch:lever:161320f1-fa.description: Farfetch is a leading global marketplace for the luxury fashion industry, connecting customers in over 190 countries with items from more than 50 countries and over 1,400 of the world’s best brands and charming boutiques from around the world. Farfetch opens a world of luxury for endless expressions of style, delivering a truly unique shopping experience and access to the most extensive selection of luxury on a global marketplace. LONDON Our London office is located in Old Street, London’s tech hub, and is home to a wide range of teams. Our open space is ideal for collaborative work and sharing ideas. We also have a large outdoor terrace, which is the perfect spot to have a team lunch or host events. COMMERCIAL The Commercial team drives our strategic partnerships with the world's leading brands and boutiques to source the best selection and optimise sales channels for our partners. Their work offers our customers access to incredible products and the most extensive selection of luxury for endless style. jobgether-jobgether:lever:7995ec3a-ad83-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Lead Site Reliability Engineer - Imunify Reliability Platform based in United Kingdom. This is a greenfield SRE leadership opportunity within a large-scale, security-focused product environment. You will define what “healthy” means across roughly 70 components spanning cloud services and customer-hosted agents. You will establish SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, monitoring standards, alerting, and escalation practices from the ground up. Your work will directly improve the ability to detect silent security-control degradation before it becomes a widespread customer-impacting issue. You will collaborate closely with engineering leads and senior engineers while building the telemetry and reliability platform yourself. The environment is remote-first, async, technically demanding, and focused on measurable outcomes rather than dashboards for their own sake. This is an opportunity to shape the reliability culture and foundations of a major security product. Define and establish meaningful SLIs for approximately 70 product components, working with squad leads and senior engineers to agree on ownership, measurement, tiering, SLOs, and error budgets. Develop a reliability taxonomy covering service availability and latency, fleet reachability and configuration convergence, security-control efficacy, artifact delivery, and telemetry pipeline health. Ensure reliability indicators are independently measurable and cannot be disabled by the same failure they are intended to detect. Design and build the telemetry collection pipeline for customer-hosted agents and cloud services, balancing push-based collection, sampling, privacy constraints, data quality, and cardinality. Extend instrumentation across Python, Go, and Rust components in collaboration with product engineering teams. Consolidate existing dashboards, queries, and reporting mechanisms into a smaller, more reliable observability platform, retiring tooling that does not provide meaningful operational value. Implement symptom-based, SLO-driven alerting with multi-window burn-rate principles and clear page, ticket, and dashboard classifications. Ensure every production alert has a defined owner, documented failure mode, and actionable runbook. Establish ongoing alert-quality practices, including periodic reviews, measurable actionable-alert rates, and deliberate removal of unnecessary alerts. Build a machine-readable ownership and escalation model that routes incidents to the appropriate engineering squads. Establish severity definitions, acknowledgement expectations, follow-the-sun escalation practices, and clean handoff procedures across multiple time zones. Strengthen incident command and blameless postmortem practices, including reliable timelines, ownership, and follow-through on corrective actions. Coach engineering squads to own their own operational responsibilities and paging rather than becoming a centralized buffer for other teams' alerts. Deliver measurable reliability outcomes over the first year, including complete SLI ownership, production telemetry, tiered alerting, squad on-call adoption, and a significant reduction in the time required to detect silent security-control degradation. Requirements Substantial production engineering or SRE experience, including experience defining and implementing an SLO framework rather than simply operating within an existing one. Strong Python skills and the ability to read and modify Go or Rust code when implementing instrumentation and reliability improvements. Strong hands-on experience with time-series and event telemetry at scale, including Prometheus/OpenMetrics, Grafana, Alertmanager-class routing systems, and columnar or high-cardinality data stores such as ClickHouse or equivalent technologies. Experience debugging distributed systems running on bare metal and long-lived hosts; this role requires more
